text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl isn't looking so good, so I take her to the infirmary to get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, Trainer! I'll be fine after a little bit of rest.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh my, where am I? Japan? No… this doesn't look like the real world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Eek! What is that squishy creature?! It's coming this way!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Stooop! Don't you know it's bad manners to attack people without warning?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Communication comes first! Now tell me why you suddenly attacked me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hmm, it doesn't seem to understand human language. In that case…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: How about a little body language? Let's converse soul to soul!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I get it now. You're feeling upset after having a fight with your friend, huh?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Even so, you can't just take your frustration out on other people. At times like these, you need open up and lay your feelings bare!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: C'mon, let it all out! I'll listen to you! We might be of different species, but there are no barriers between us!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Let's share a laugh together as a symbol of our friendship! Laughter is the language that transcends all boundaries! Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I knew it—overcoming language barriers is easy as pie! Even different species can understand each other!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Perhaps it was due to her pleasant dream, but Seeking the Pearl now appears back to her usual self!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh no! It seems even angrier than before!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: What did I do to upset it so much?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I couldn't get my feelings across… My body language just isn't up to snuff yet…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Perhaps it's the fault of the bad dream she had, but Seeking the Pearl is unable to get back to her usual self.
